scripts.dev: shadow-cljs watch app & clojure -M:server -m demo.server & vite
scripts.dev:local: shadow-cljs -A:local watch app & clojure -M:server:local -m demo.server & vite
scripts.build: shadow-cljs release app && vite build && clojure -T:build uber
scripts.build:local: shadow-cljs -A:local release app && vite build && LOCAL=1 clojure -T:build uber
